lines.text: The LORD longs to be gracious, and the people in Zion who dwell in Jerusalem will weep no more.
The Teacher will no longer hide Himself, and the people will hear a command behind them: "Walk in it."
The people will throw away their idols, and the LORD will send frost for the seed they have sown.
The people will sing as on a holy festival night, and Babylon will be shattered by the LORD.
Topheth has long been prepared for the king, and the breath of the LORD sets its pyre ablaze.
